annotations.title: Find the best verified paid API or agent for a task (x402 exchange)

description:
Describe a task and get up to 5 paid endpoints that can do it, ranked on merit only (match, trust, latency, price): each listed seller was checked by preflight (real 402, price, payTo, domain, TLS) and the top picks are re-probed live. Every offer carries the exact call, the live price and a ready shield-check body for before you pay. You pay the seller directly; Angel never holds funds. 0.01 USDC base (new payers 0.01, >10 payments 0.007; 1 pack call).
After: shield-check before paying the offer you pick, then call it (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Token from buy_signal_pack or buy_pack_with_card instead of paying per call.

max_usd.description: highest price per call you accept

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from: the payment-required error quotes your tier (0 payments base price (new-payer surcharge paused), 1-10 base, >10 -30 %) and, from the third payment, an upgrade with your own spend.

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.
